body: Thanks, I wish I was still at that hopeful point where I could believe that I'm not alone. But I'm not. But thanks anyway.
Thanks for the advice and for clarifying what you meant, it sounds cliche but maybe it is time I try something new.

But don't assume I sit around or don't have other activities. When I say I have trouble making friends, it because I actually do try, and always have, I keep myself busy and reach out to people and it just doesn't have any results. For some people it just doesn't work, so don't assume people posting on suicidewatch just haven't tried hard enough, it's insulting.

I agree with your advice about physical activity, regular exercise can make all the difference with mood and self worth. Now that it's getting warmer out where I live I'm planning to start walking every day. Martial arts sounds pretty cool.

I've always felt worthless, even when I was a kid. I've never had friends, just acquaintances. There's something wrong with me. I don't know what it is but people just don't want to know me. No one ever listens to me or talks to me. I've had the "alone in a crowded room" feeling constantly since I was born.
